title: 从Java开发者到AI工程师的完整路线图
summary: 提供从Java开发者转型为AI工程师的逐步路线图，涵盖Python、机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI、RAG、智能体AI、LLM工程、微调、MLOps及生产级AI系统。
summary_en: A complete step-by-step roadmap for transitioning from Java Developer to AI Engineer, covering Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, RAG, Agentic AI, LLM Engineering, Fine-Tuning, MLOps, and Production AI Systems.
